people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Bamoth-baal
people.line: Moabite high place where Balak took Balaam.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
translations.bsb: For a fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the rulers of Arnon’s heights.
translations.kjv: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
translations.asv: For a fire is gone out of Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon: It hath devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
